name: PT100 RTD
description: The PT100 is a platinum resistance temperature detector (RTD) with a nominal resistance of 100Ω at 0°C. It offers excellent linearity and accuracy across a wide temperature range and is a common choice for high-accuracy temperature measurement in industrial and 3D printing applications. Because its resistance change per degree is small, a dedicated amplifier such as the MAX31865 is required to interface with a standard 3D printer control board. In Klipper, the 'PT100 INA826' sensor type is used when paired with an INA826-based amplifier.
